either broadly defined or more narrowly defined as multiple strategy/fluency lessons exactly as it

decisions.location: Discussion pp.37–38, full-sample replication conclusion before exploratory school-poverty contrasts
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly state an overall failure-to-replicate verdict for the full sample on the primary replication question, while the school-level poverty interaction was conducted as an exploratory moderation analysis.

corrected_value.title: Effects of a voluntary summer reading intervention on reading achievement: Results from a randomized field trial.

decisions.quote: We also compared the performance of control group students in moderate and high poverty schools in this study with the two studies of READS that we were attempting to replicate. As shown in Figure 5, in the initial studies, as in high poverty schools in this study, control group students lost ground in the summer, d = - .07 (Kim, 2006) and d = - .08 (Kim & White, 2008).
decisions.location: Results > Differences in Control Group Performance, p. 34, lines 806-809
decisions.reason: The paper explicitly states that the randomized trial was designed to replicate two initial experimental studies of READS—Kim (2006) and Kim and White (2008)—making Kim (2006) an omitted replication target with a failed outcome.

prior_outcome_quote: In the Coyne et al. (2013) study, as in our study, differences in the response of comparison group students explained the failure to replicate.

parent_source_inspection.note: Read original-specific full-sample verdict and subsequent exploratory high-poverty subgroup results. Retain failed full-sample verdict; Kim2006 explicitly named second target. Replaced Coyne analogy quotation with direct full-sample verdict.
